0022600029.text: The Thunder (6-2) head into this 9th game of their season on a two-game winning streak and sit 2nd in the Northwest, while the Grizzlies (6-2) are on a two-game losing streak and sit 3rd in the Southwest. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (out, shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (out, knee), Jalen Williams (out, leg fracture), Nikola Topic (out, back), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee), and Jaylin Williams is day-to-day with back spasms and a game-time decision. Memphis is missing Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness), and Isaiah Stewart is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Thunder won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 117-116 win in Memphis on January 9, 2026.
